name: custom_values_per_attribute_value
source_sql: SELECT custom_product_template_attribute_value_id AS "customProductTemplateAttributeValueId", COUNT(*) AS n FROM product_attribute_custom_value GROUP BY custom_product_template_attribute_value_id ORDER BY custom_product_template_attribute_value_id

name: parentless_custom_values
source_sql: SELECT id AS "_id", custom_product_template_attribute_value_id AS "customProductTemplateAttributeValueId", custom_value AS "customValue" FROM product_attribute_custom_value WHERE sale_order_line_id IS NULL ORDER BY id

name: custom_values_by_sale_order_line
source_sql: SELECT sale_order_line_id AS "saleOrderLineId", id AS "_id", custom_value AS "customValue" FROM product_attribute_custom_value WHERE sale_order_line_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sale_order_line_id, id

name: layouts_per_print_format
source_sql: SELECT print_format AS "printFormat", COUNT(*) AS n FROM product_label_layout GROUP BY print_format ORDER BY print_format

name: layout_header_read
source_sql: SELECT id AS "_id", print_format AS "printFormat", custom_quantity AS "customQuantity", with_price AS "withPrice", move_quantity AS "moveQuantity", print_packaging AS "printPackaging", pricelist_id AS "pricelistId", packaging_id AS "packagingId" FROM product_label_layout ORDER BY id
